sim-to-real gap.reason: rendered warehouses only; a small real-to-sim check is planned but the gap remains

synthetic data only.reason: all scenes are rendered in Isaac Sim

task coverage.reason: 5 categories, 50 sub-tasks of spatial skills, one per room; long episodes test memory across rooms and moving between labelled doors, not open-ended planning; no manipulation or language-heavy tasks

embodiment or action space.reason: step, turn, look and go through a labelled door to the next room only; no picking up in v1

compute or cost.reason: full navigation takes about 90 to 150 model calls per 30-room episode (3 to 5 moves per room), so API runs are costly; the first spend is capped at $2,000 for all providers together and the cost per episode is to be recomputed

modality coverage.reason: Rendered RGB views only, the limit MetaSpace states; the moves give several views, which covers only part of it.

answer format.reason: Multiple choice and numbers checked by rules: the same format and extraction limits the rivals admit.

model coverage.reason: Depends on which models are run. Planned: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Kimi-K3, Qwen and Grok through APIs, no open models. Every model gets the same input: each call its current view, its previous view and its own notes (2 pictures per call, so Kimi-K3's 30-picture cap is never hit).

reproducibility or release.reason: Release planned; API agents are not deterministic, one run per setting gives no spread, and asset licences may limit redistribution.

ours_layer_audit: Devil's-advocate audit (/audit-novelty, fresh agent, 2026-09-30): 2 of 5 "addressed" kinds downgraded to shared (judge, contamination), 3 reworded to say planned and not unique, 3 "not addressed" moved to shared. Nothing is built yet: every "addressed" is a plan.
